# Use optional method calls where an Account Hub subview may lack that operation

Finish handling historically called captureState on every subview. Accepted submit/forward handling keeps the required currentSubview lookup but calls captureState?.() before dispatching the state transition. This permits a subview without a capture method; it does not permit a missing current subview or guarantee every state accepts undefined data. Keep optional chaining scoped to the optional operation and check the state-specific consumer. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: Account Hub forward capture contract.
